rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for continuing stubbornly or resolutely, especially with an action or goal.

example.english: I will persist with my daily practice until I make the team.
example.traditional: 我會堅持每日練波，直到入選為止。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 gin1 ci4 mui5 jat6 lin6 bo1 zik6 dou3 jap6 syun2 wai4 zi2

rows.note: Use this when an organism, thing, or problem remains in existence rather than when someone continues an action.

example.english: This problem has continued to persist for so many years.
example.traditional: 呢個問題咁多年都仲存在。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 gam3 do1 nin4 dou1 zung6 cyun4 zoi6
